objects.name: automation_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE automation_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,profile_json TEXT NOT NULL,profile_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(device_id,profile_sha256))

objects.name: controls
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE controls(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL,
            command_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,command_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(job_id,version))

objects.name: runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id),user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            window_end TEXT NOT NULL,profile_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
            started_at TEXT NOT NULL,finished_at TEXT,result_json TEXT,error_code TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(job_id,window_end,profile_sha256))

objects.name: attempts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),number INTEGER NOT NULL,
            trigger TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,started_at TEXT NOT NULL,finished_at TEXT,error_code TEXT,
            request_id TEXT NOT NULL,job_version INTEGER NOT NULL,UNIQUE(run_id,number))

objects.name: input_changes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE input_changes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
            input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(run_id,input_sha256))

objects.name: idx_automation_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_automation_owner ON jobs(user_id,season_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: idx_runs_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_runs_owner ON runs(user_id,job_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: followup_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE followup_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: cases
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE cases(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,assessment_json TEXT NOT NULL,assessment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(id,user_id))

objects.name: events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,case_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            version INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(case_id,version),
            FOREIGN KEY(case_id,user_id) REFERENCES cases(id,user_id))

objects.name: idx_followup_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_followup_owner ON cases(user_id,season_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: current_cases
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW current_cases AS SELECT c.*,e.version,e.state,e.created_at AS updated_at FROM cases c
            JOIN events e ON e.case_id=c.id WHERE e.version=(SELECT MAX(x.version) FROM events x WHERE x.case_id=c.id)

objects.name: episode_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE episode_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: episodes
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE episodes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,profile_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,task_kind TEXT NOT NULL,case_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(case_id,user_id) REFERENCES cases(id,user_id))

objects.name: episode_members
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE episode_members(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,episode_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES episodes(id),
            assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL,window_end TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(episode_id,assessment_id))

objects.name: idx_episode_scope
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_episode_scope ON episodes(user_id,season_id,device_id,profile_sha256,task_kind)

objects.name: episode_heads
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW episode_heads AS SELECT p.*,c.state,c.version,c.updated_at,
            (SELECT MIN(window_end) FROM episode_members m WHERE m.episode_id=p.id) first_window,
            (SELECT MAX(window_end) FROM episode_members m WHERE m.episode_id=p.id) latest_window,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM episode_members m WHERE m.episode_id=p.id) assessment_count
            FROM episodes p JOIN current_cases c ON c.id=p.case_id AND c.user_id=p.user_id

objects.name: assessment_version_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE assessment_version_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: assessment_versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assessment_versions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,base_assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            season_id TEXT NOT NULL,device_id TEXT NOT NULL,profile_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            previous_id TEXT NOT NULL,base_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(base_assessment_id,revision),UNIQUE(base_assessment_id,input_sha256))

objects.name: assessment_version_attempts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE assessment_version_attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,base_assessment_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            input_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,finished_at TEXT,error_code TEXT,
            request_id TEXT NOT NULL,version_id TEXT)

objects.name: idx_version_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_version_owner ON assessment_versions(user_id,season_id,base_assessment_id,revision)

objects.name: idx_version_attempt
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_version_attempt ON assessment_version_attempts(base_assessment_id,input_sha256,created_at)

objects.name: journal_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE journal_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: visits
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE visits(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('synthetic','field_observed')),observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            scheduled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(scheduled IN (0,1)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(id,user_id))

objects.name: revisions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,visit_id TEXT NOT NULL,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            change_reason TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(visit_id,revision),FOREIGN KEY(visit_id,user_id) REFERENCES visits(id,user_id))

objects.name: idx_journal_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_journal_owner ON visits(user_id,season_id,observed_at,id)

objects.name: history
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW history AS SELECT r.*,v.season_id,v.source,v.observed_at,v.scheduled
            FROM revisions r JOIN visits v ON v.id=r.visit_id AND v.user_id=r.user_id

objects.name: current_records
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW current_records AS SELECT h.* FROM history h WHERE
            h.revision=(SELECT MAX(x.revision) FROM revisions x WHERE x.visit_id=h.visit_id)

objects.name: management_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE management_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: interventions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE interventions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source IN ('synthetic','field_observed')),at TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(id,user_id))

objects.name: intervention_revisions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE intervention_revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,intervention_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            user_id TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,change_reason TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(intervention_id,revision),FOREIGN KEY(intervention_id,user_id) REFERENCES interventions(id,user_id))

objects.name: idx_management_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_management_owner ON interventions(user_id,season_id,at,id)

objects.name: management_history
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW management_history AS SELECT r.*,i.season_id,i.source,i.at
            FROM intervention_revisions r JOIN interventions i ON i.id=r.intervention_id AND i.user_id=r.user_id

objects.name: management_current
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW management_current AS SELECT h.* FROM management_history h WHERE
            h.revision=(SELECT MAX(x.revision) FROM intervention_revisions x WHERE x.intervention_id=h.intervention_id)

objects.name: research_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE research_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: records
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE records(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: events
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,record_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES records(id),
            version INTEGER NOT NULL,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,command_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            command_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,data_json TEXT NOT NULL,data_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            request_id TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(record_id,version))

objects.name: idx_research_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_research_owner ON records(user_id,season_id,kind,created_at,id)

objects.name: current_records
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW current_records AS SELECT r.*,e.version,e.state,e.data_json AS current_data_json,
            e.created_at AS updated_at FROM records r JOIN events e ON e.record_id=r.id
            WHERE e.version=(SELECT MAX(x.version) FROM events x WHERE x.record_id=r.id)

objects.name: telemetry_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE telemetry_meta(kind TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: streams
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE streams(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            client_stream_id TEXT NOT NULL,metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,metadata_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(id,user_id),UNIQUE(user_id,client_stream_id))

objects.name: samples
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE samples(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,stream_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            qc_json TEXT NOT NULL,received_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(stream_id,observed_at),UNIQUE(id,user_id),
            FOREIGN KEY(stream_id,user_id) REFERENCES streams(id,user_id))

objects.name: exclusions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE exclusions(sample_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            reason TEXT NOT NULL,recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(sample_id,user_id) REFERENCES samples(id,user_id))

objects.name: idx_raw_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_raw_owner ON samples(user_id,stream_id,observed_at,id)

objects.name: idx_stream_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_stream_owner ON streams(user_id,season_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: raw_records
objects.sql:
CREATE VIEW raw_records AS SELECT s.*,e.reason AS exclusion_reason,e.recorded_at AS excluded_at,
            e.request_id AS exclusion_request_id FROM samples s LEFT JOIN exclusions e ON e.sample_id=s.id

objects.name: hourly_policies
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE hourly_policies(
            stream_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(stream_id,user_id,revision),
            FOREIGN KEY(stream_id,user_id) REFERENCES streams(id,user_id))

objects.name: hourly_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE hourly_sources(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, stream_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            season_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, policy_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            compile_key TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(stream_id,user_id,revision), UNIQUE(stream_id,user_id,compile_key),
            FOREIGN KEY(stream_id,user_id,policy_revision)
                REFERENCES hourly_policies(stream_id,user_id,revision))

objects.name: hourly_sources_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX hourly_sources_owner ON hourly_sources(user_id,stream_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: synthetic_forecasts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE synthetic_forecasts(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            scenario TEXT NOT NULL, model_pin TEXT NOT NULL, input_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(user_id,season_id,scenario,model_pin,input_hash))

objects.name: synthetic_forecast_inputs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE synthetic_forecast_inputs(
            forecast_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id), input_json TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: synthetic_hourly_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE synthetic_hourly_sources(
            season_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            input_hash TEXT NOT NULL, hourly_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(season_id,user_id,revision))

objects.name: synthetic_forecast_hourly_sources
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE synthetic_forecast_hourly_sources(
            forecast_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id),
            hourly_source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES hourly_sources(id))

objects.name: forecast_alert_policies
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_alert_policies(
            version TEXT PRIMARY KEY,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: forecast_alerts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_alerts(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            forecast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id),scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            policy_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_alert_policies(version),
            kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('score_threshold','data_quality')),
            issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,target_window_end TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('unread','acknowledged')),
            version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version IN (1,2)),created_at TEXT NOT NULL,acknowledged_at TEXT,
            UNIQUE(forecast_id,policy_version))

objects.name: idx_forecast_alert_owner
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_forecast_alert_owner
            ON forecast_alerts(user_id,season_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: forecast_alert_evaluations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_alert_evaluations(
            forecast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id),
            policy_version TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_alert_policies(version),user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,outcome TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT,
            alert_id TEXT REFERENCES forecast_alerts(id),evaluated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(forecast_id,policy_version))

objects.name: forecast_alert_states
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_alert_states(
            scope_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            latest_issue_us INTEGER NOT NULL,latest_forecast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id),
            score_alert_id TEXT REFERENCES forecast_alerts(id),data_alert_id TEXT REFERENCES forecast_alerts(id))

objects.name: forecast_alert_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_alert_actions(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,alert_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_alerts(id),user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action='acknowledge'),base_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(alert_id,action))

objects.name: forecast_outcome_links
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_outcome_links(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL,season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            forecast_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id),kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('observation','followup')),
            reference_id TEXT NOT NULL,reference_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            command_json TEXT NOT NULL,command_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,snapshot_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','retracted')),
            version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version IN (1,2)),retracted_at TEXT)

objects.name: idx_forecast_outcome_active
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_forecast_outcome_active
            ON forecast_outcome_links(forecast_id,kind,reference_id,reference_revision) WHERE state='active'

objects.name: idx_forecast_outcome_owner
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_forecast_outcome_owner
            ON forecast_outcome_links(user_id,forecast_id,created_at,id)

objects.name: forecast_outcome_actions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_outcome_actions(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,link_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_outcome_links(id),user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action='retract'),base_version INTEGER NOT NULL,reason TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(link_id,action))

objects.name: forecast_jobs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_jobs(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, season_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            stream_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, interval_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,
            enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, next_run_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, command_json TEXT NOT NULL, command_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE(user_id,stream_id), FOREIGN KEY(stream_id,user_id) REFERENCES streams(id,user_id))

objects.name: forecast_runs
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_runs(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, forecast_job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_jobs(id),
            user_id TEXT NOT NULL, season_id TEXT NOT NULL, job_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
            scheduled_at TEXT NOT NULL, issued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            hourly_source_id TEXT REFERENCES hourly_sources(id), model_pin TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            forecast_id TEXT REFERENCES synthetic_forecasts(id), error_code TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, UNIQUE(forecast_job_id,scheduled_at,job_version))

objects.name: forecast_one_active_run
objects.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX forecast_one_active_run
            ON forecast_runs(forecast_job_id) WHERE status IN ('pending','retry','running')

objects.name: forecast_attempts
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE forecast_attempts(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, forecast_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES forecast_runs(id),
            number INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            finished_at TEXT, error_code TEXT, UNIQUE(forecast_run_id,number))

objects.name: forecast_runs_owner
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX forecast_runs_owner ON forecast_runs(user_id,forecast_job_id,created_at,id)
